crossRefs.note: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’ ”

translations.web: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
translations.bsb: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.
